name: Hello World
description: Types a single greeting line. Useful as a first smoke test of keystroke injection.

name: Open URL (Windows)
description: Opens the Run dialog and launches the default browser to a URL.
script:
DELAY 1000
GUI r
DELAY 500
STRING https://example.com
ENTER

name: Notepad Note (Windows)
description: Opens Notepad via the Run dialog and types a short reminder note.
script:
DELAY 1000
GUI r
DELAY 500
STRING notepad
ENTER
DELAY 1000
STRING This machine was tested with authorization.
ENTER

name: Lock Workstation (Windows)
description: Locks the current Windows session using the Win+L shortcut.

name: Show IP Config (Windows)
description: Opens a command prompt and prints the network configuration.
script:
DELAY 1000
GUI r
DELAY 500
STRING cmd
ENTER
DELAY 1000
STRING ipconfig /all
ENTER

name: System Info (Windows)
description: Opens a command prompt and shows basic system information.
script:
DELAY 1000
GUI r
DELAY 500
STRING cmd
ENTER
DELAY 1000
STRING systeminfo
ENTER

name: Spotlight Note (macOS)
description: Uses Spotlight to open the Notes app and types a short note.
script:
DELAY 1000
GUI SPACE
DELAY 500
STRING Notes
ENTER
DELAY 1500
GUI n
DELAY 500
STRING Authorized test note.
ENTER

name: Open URL (macOS)
description: Uses Spotlight to open Safari and navigate to a URL.
script:
DELAY 1000
GUI SPACE
DELAY 500
STRING Safari
ENTER
DELAY 1500
GUI l
DELAY 500
STRING https://example.com
ENTER

name: Lock Screen (macOS)
description: Locks the macOS screen using the Control+Command+Q shortcut.

name: Terminal Echo (Linux)
description: Opens a terminal via the activities search and echoes a message.
script:
DELAY 1000
GUI
DELAY 500
STRING terminal
ENTER
DELAY 1500
STRING echo Authorized test on this host
ENTER

name: Show IP Address (Linux)
description: Opens a terminal and prints the host network addresses.
script:
DELAY 1000
GUI
DELAY 500
STRING terminal
ENTER
DELAY 1500
STRING ip addr
ENTER

name: Close Window
description: Closes the active window using the common Alt+F4 shortcut on Windows.
